q: Choose the correct sentence for Writing Task 1.
o: The number of tourists rose dramatically.
The number of tourists raised dramatically.
The number of tourists was risen dramatically.
The number of tourist rose dramatically.
e: «rise–rose–risen» to'ldiruvchisiz ishlatiladi. «raise» esa biror narsani ko'tarmoq, to'ldiruvchi talab qiladi: raise prices.

q: Sales increased ______ 20% in 2010 ______ 35% in 2020.
e: «from X to Y» boshlang'ich va yakuniy qiymatni ko'rsatadi. «by» esa o'zgarish miqdori uchun: increased by 15 percentage points.

q: The price of oil rose ______ 15%, from $60 to $69.
e: O'zgarish miqdori «by» bilan beriladi: rose by 15%. «to» esa yakuniy qiymatni bildiradi: rose to $69.

q: There was a ______ in unemployment in 2015.
e: Artikldan keyin sifat + ot keladi: a sharp rise. «sharply» ravish, fe'l bilan ishlatiladi: rose sharply.

q: Which phrase means 'stayed at the same level' in a Task 1 report?
e: remained stable = o'zgarmadi. fluctuated = goh oshib, goh tushdi. peaked = eng yuqori nuqtaga chiqdi. plummeted = keskin tushdi.

q: The figure was 40% in 2000 and 20% in 2010. Which sentence is accurate?
o: The figure halved over the decade.
The figure doubled over the decade.
The figure fell by 40 percentage points.
e: 40% dan 20% ga tushish ikki baravar kamayish (halved), ya'ni 20 foiz punktga tushish.

q: The proportion of students who cycled ______ from 12% in 2005 to 18% in 2015.
e: O'tgan yillar ma'lumoti Past Simple bilan yoziladi. Bu yerda «increase» o'timsiz, majhul nisbat kerak emas.

q: Approximately ______ of the population lives in cities.
e: Surati 1 dan katta kasrlar ko'plikda yoziladi: two-thirds, three-quarters.

q: Which phrase is the most suitable for an academic Task 1 report?
e: Task 1 akademik uslubda yoziladi: a significant increase, a slight decrease.

q: What should the overview in Task 1 contain?
o: The main trends or biggest differences
e: Overview'da asosiy tendensiyalar va eng katta farqlar beriladi. Shaxsiy fikr va sabablar Task 1 da talab qilinmaydi.

q: Which tense is usually used to describe a process diagram?
e: Jarayon doim takrorlanadi, bajaruvchi esa muhim emas: The leaves are collected and then dried.

q: By 2030, the number of cars ______ to reach 5 million.
e: Bashorat uchun: is expected / is predicted / is projected to + fe'l.

q: The ______ of men and women in the survey was almost equal.
e: «The ... of» qolipidan keyin ot kerak: proportion (ulush).

q: ______ for the IELTS exam since September.
e: «since September»: harakat o'tmishda boshlangan va hozir ham davom etyapti. Present Perfect Continuous kerak.

q: Choose the correct sentence.
o: I am agree with this opinion.
I am agreed with this opinion.
e: «agree» fe'l, oldidan «am» kerak emas. «I am agree» o'zbek o'quvchilarining eng ko'p uchraydigan xatosi.

q: Which phrase is correct?
e: «information» sanalmaydigan ot: much information, a piece of information. Ko'plik shakli yo'q.

q: Which phrase is correct?
e: «advice» sanalmaydi: some advice, a piece of advice. «useful» [ju:] tovushi bilan boshlanadi, shuning uchun «a useful».

q: Which sentence is correct?
o: Unemployment is a serious problem in many countries.
The unemployment is a serious problem in many countries.
An unemployment is a serious problem in many countries.
Unemployments are a serious problem in many countries.
e: Umumiy ma'nodagi mavhum otlar artiklsiz ishlatiladi: unemployment, education, pollution.

q: If governments ______ public transport, fewer people would drive.
e: Ikkinchi tur shart gap: If + Past Simple, ... would + fe'l.

q: If you ______ every day, your English will improve.
e: Birinchi tur shart gap: If + Present Simple, ... will + fe'l. «If» qismida «will» ishlatilmaydi.

q: The bridge ______ in 1990.
e: Ko'prik o'zi qurmagan, uni qurishgan. O'tgan zamon majhul nisbati: was + V3 (built).

q: Which linking word shows contrast?
e: whereas = holbuki, ziddiyat. moreover va furthermore fikr qo'shadi, therefore esa natijani bildiradi.

q: ______ the high cost, many families choose private schools.
e: «Despite»dan keyin ot yoki -ing keladi: despite the high cost. «Although»dan keyin to'liq gap kerak.

q: ______ it was raining, the match continued.
e: To'liq gap (it was raining) oldidan «Although» ishlatiladi. «Despite» va «In spite of»dan keyin faqat ot keladi.

q: Choose the correct sentence.
o: Children should be taught how to manage money.
Children should taught how to manage money.
Children should be teach how to manage money.
Children should be teaching how manage money.
e: Modal fe'l bilan majhul nisbat: should + be + V3 (taught).

q: It is ______ that the government acts now.
e: «It is»dan keyin sifat keladi: It is essential/important/vital that...

q: The more you read, ______ your vocabulary becomes.
e: Qolip: The more ..., the + qiyosiy daraja (the richer).

q: She has lived in London ______ five years.
e: «for» davomiylikni (five years), «since» boshlanish nuqtasini (since 2019) bildiradi.

q: I look forward to ______ from you.
e: «look forward to» dagi «to» predlog, undan keyin -ing keladi: look forward to hearing.

q: Many students are used to ______ up late.
e: «be used to + -ing» biror narsaga odatlanib qolmoq degani. «used to + fe'l» esa o'tmishdagi odatni bildiradi.

q: Choose the correct comparison.
o: Cycling is much healthier than driving.
Cycling is more healthier than driving.
Cycling is much more healthy that driving.
Cycling is the healthier than driving.
e: «healthier» o'zi qiyosiy daraja, oldidan «more» qo'shilmaydi. Kuchaytirish uchun «much» ishlatiladi.

q: The ______ of the new law took two years.
e: «The ... of» qolipida ot kerak: implementation (joriy etish).

q: Not only ______ cheaper, but it is also faster.
e: «Not only» gap boshida kelsa, inversiya bo'ladi: Not only is the train cheaper...

q: Which opening is the most suitable for formal writing?
e: Rasmiy yozuvda umumiy da'vo ehtiyotkorlik bilan beriladi: It is widely believed / It is often argued that...

q: A large ______ of people use social media every day.
e: Sanaladigan otlar bilan «number», sanalmaydiganlar bilan «amount» ishlatiladi: a large amount of time.

q: The amount of ______ produced each year is increasing.
e: «amount of» sanalmaydigan ot bilan keladi: waste. Sanaladiganlar uchun «the number of cars».

q: Which sentence uses 'whereas' correctly?
o: Men preferred football, whereas women chose tennis.
Men preferred football whereas, women chose tennis.
Whereas men preferred football. Women chose tennis.
Men preferred football; whereas women chose tennis.
e: «whereas» ikki gapni vergul bilan bog'laydi. Undan keyin vergul qo'yilmaydi va uni alohida gap qilib bo'lmaydi.

q: Each of the students ______ a laptop.
e: «Each of» birlik fe'l talab qiladi: Each of the students has.

q: Neither of the solutions ______ perfect.
e: Rasmiy uslubda «Neither of» birlik fe'l bilan ishlatiladi.

q: It's high time the government ______ action.
e: «It's high time»dan keyin Past Simple keladi, garchi ma'no hozirgi bo'lsa ham.

q: Choose the correct sentence.
o: Nowadays, many people work from home.
Nowadays many people works from home.
Now a days, many people work from home.
Nowdays, many people work from home.
e: «Nowadays» bitta so'z bo'lib yoziladi. «people» ko'plik, shuning uchun «work».

q: Which spelling is correct?
e: Listening'da imlo xatosi javobni noto'g'ri qiladi. So'zda «n» ham, «m» ham bor: enviroNMent.

q: Which spelling is correct?
e: Ikkita «c» va ikkita «m»: aCCoMModation. Listening'da juda ko'p uchraydi.

q: Which spelling is correct?
e: goverN + Ment: «n» harfi tushib qolmasin.

q: Which spelling is correct?
e: Bitta «c», ikkita «s»: neCeSSary.

q: Which spelling is correct?
e: Hafta kunlari va oylar bosh harf bilan, to'g'ri imloda yozilishi shart: Wednesday.

q: Which spelling is correct?
e: FebRUary: birinchi «r» ko'pincha tushib qoladi.

q: Which spelling is correct?
e: LibRary: ikkinchi «r» yozilishi shart.

q: Which spelling is correct?
e: rest-au-rant: o'rtadagi «au» ni eslab qoling.

q: Which spelling is correct?
e: Ikkita «n»: questioNNaire. So'rovnoma mavzusidagi Listening'larda tez-tez chiqadi.

q: Which spelling is correct?
e: Qoida: «c»dan keyin «ei»: reCEIpt. «p» harfi talaffuz qilinmaydi, lekin yoziladi.

q: Choose the correct collocation.
e: «make a decision» to'g'ri birikma. Britaniya inglizchasida «take a decision» ham ishlatiladi.

q: Choose the correct collocation.
e: «do» ish va vazifalar bilan keladi: do homework, do research, do exercise.

q: Choose the correct collocation.
e: «pay attention to» e'tibor bermoq degani.

q: Governments should ______ action to reduce pollution.
e: «take action» chora ko'rmoq degani. Shunga o'xshash: take measures, take steps.

q: Many people ______ a living by working online.
e: «make a living» (yoki earn a living) tirikchilik qilmoq degani.

q: Exercise has a positive ______ on mental health.
e: «have an effect on» birikmasi. «affect» fe'l, «effect» esa ot.

q: Smoking ______ a serious risk to health.
e: «pose a risk/threat» xavf tug'dirmoq degani. Bu Writing'da juda foydali birikma.

q: Students need to ______ a balance between study and rest.
e: «strike a balance» muvozanat topmoq degani. «find a balance» ham to'g'ri.

q: Air pollution has reached ______ levels in some cities.
e: -ing sifat narsaning xususiyatini bildiradi: alarming levels. -ed esa insonning hissi: I was alarmed.

q: The government should ______ more money in education.
e: «invest in» biror sohaga sarmoya kiritmoq. «spend on» ham bo'ladi, lekin «spend in» noto'g'ri.

q: Online shopping ______ convenience to busy people.
e: «offer convenience/benefits» qulaylik taqdim etmoq.

q: We need to raise ______ about recycling.
e: «raise awareness of/about» xabardorlikni oshirmoq. Fe'ldan keyin ot kerak.

q: Technology plays an important ______ in education.
e: «play a role in» rol o'ynamoq. «roll» esa talaffuzi bir xil, lekin boshqa so'z.

q: How many questions are in the IELTS Listening test?
e: Listening 4 qismdan va jami 40 ta savoldan iborat.

q: How many parts does the IELTS Listening test have?
e: 4 qism: 1-2 kundalik vaziyatlar, 3-4 akademik mavzular (suhbat va ma'ruza).

q: How long is the IELTS Academic Reading test?
e: 60 daqiqa, 3 matn, 40 savol. Javoblarni ko'chirish uchun qo'shimcha vaqt berilmaydi.

q: How many passages are in IELTS Academic Reading?
e: 3 ta uzun matn, odatda har biri oldingisidan qiyinroq.

q: How long is the IELTS Speaking test?
e: Speaking 11–14 daqiqa davom etadi va 3 qismdan iborat.

q: In Speaking Part 2, how long do you get to prepare?
e: 1 daqiqa tayyorgarlik beriladi, qog'oz va qalam bilan. Keyin 1–2 daqiqa gapirasiz.

q: In Speaking Part 2, how long should you speak?
e: 1–2 daqiqa gapirish kerak. Imtihonchi 2 daqiqada to'xtatadi, shuning uchun to'liq 2 daqiqaga mo'ljallang.

q: Which Writing task counts for more of the Writing score?
e: Task 2 baholashda Task 1 dan ikki baravar ko'p og'irlikka ega. Shuning uchun unga 40 daqiqa ajrating.

q: What is the minimum word count for Writing Task 1?
e: Task 1 kamida 150 so'z. Kam yozsangiz, Task Achievement bali tushadi.

q: What is the minimum word count for Writing Task 2?
e: Task 2 kamida 250 so'z. Odatda 260–300 so'z yetarli.

q: How many criteria are used to score IELTS Speaking?
e: 4 mezon: Fluency and Coherence, Lexical Resource, Grammatical Range and Accuracy, Pronunciation.

q: Which of these is NOT a Writing assessment criterion?
e: Pronunciation faqat Speaking'da baholanadi. Writing'ning to'rtinchi mezoni Task Achievement yoki Task Response.

q: What is the recommended time for Writing Task 2?
e: Writing 60 daqiqa: 20 daqiqa Task 1 ga, 40 daqiqa Task 2 ga tavsiya etiladi.

q: What is the recommended time for Writing Task 1?
e: 20 daqiqa. Task 1 ga ko'proq vaqt ketsa, qimmatroq Task 2 ga vaqt qolmaydi.

q: Section bands: 6.5, 6.5, 6.5 and 7.0. What is the overall band?
e: O'rtacha 6.625. U 6.75 ga yetmagani uchun 6.5 ga yaxlitlanadi. Aynan .25 va .75 esa yuqoriga yaxlitlanadi.

q: Section bands: 6.0, 6.5, 6.5 and 6.0. What is the overall band?
e: O'rtacha 6.25. IELTS qoidasiga ko'ra .25 yuqoriga, ya'ni 6.5 ga yaxlitlanadi.

q: Section bands: 7.0, 7.5, 7.0 and 7.5. What is the overall band?
e: O'rtacha 7.25, u yuqoriga 7.5 ga yaxlitlanadi.

q: Section bands: 5.5, 6.0, 6.0 and 6.0. What is the overall band?
e: O'rtacha 5.875 eng yaqin butun yoki yarim balga yaxlitlanadi, ya'ni 6.0.

q: When should you choose NOT GIVEN in a TRUE / FALSE / NOT GIVEN question?
o: When the passage gives no information about the statement
When the statement is partly true
When you cannot find the answer quickly
e: FALSE: matn aksini aytadi. NOT GIVEN: matnda bu haqda umuman ma'lumot yo'q.

q: The instructions say 'NO MORE THAN TWO WORDS'. Which answer is acceptable?
e: Ikki so'zdan oshgan javob noto'g'ri hisoblanadi. «the city centre» uch so'z.

q: The instructions say 'ONE WORD AND/OR A NUMBER'. Which answer fits?
e: «15 May» bitta raqam va bitta so'z. Qolganlarida so'zlar ko'p.

q: In Matching Headings, what is the best approach?
o: Find each paragraph's main idea, then match it to a heading
Read every word of the passage slowly
Match headings by finding the same words
e: Sarlavha abzasning asosiy g'oyasiga mos keladi, alohida so'zga emas. Bir xil so'zlar ko'pincha tuzoq bo'ladi.

q: In most completion tasks, where do the answers usually appear in the passage?
o: In the same order as the questions
e: Ko'p savol turlarida javoblar matn tartibida keladi. Matching Headings va Matching Information bundan mustasno.

q: Which sentence is a paraphrase of 'The number of visitors doubled'?
e: IELTS savollarda matnni boshqa so'zlar bilan qayta ifodalaydi: doubled = twice as many.

q: Which word might the test use instead of 'children'?
e: Sinonimlarni taniy bilish Reading va Listening'da hal qiluvchi: children = youngsters, kids, minors.

q: In IELTS Listening, when should you read the questions?
e: Har qism oldidan savollarni o'qishga vaqt beriladi. Kalit so'zlarni belgilab, javob turini oldindan taxmin qiling.

q: The speaker says: 'It's on Tuesday... oh no, sorry, Thursday.' What do you write?
e: IELTS'da so'zlovchi ko'pincha gapini tuzatadi. Har doim oxirgi, tuzatilgan ma'lumotni yozing.

q: In the computer-based IELTS Listening test, what happens after the recording ends?
o: You get about 2 minutes to check answers
You get 10 minutes to transfer answers
The test ends with no extra time
You can listen to the recording again
e: Kompyuterda javoblar darhol kiritiladi, oxirida tekshirishga taxminan 2 daqiqa beriladi. Qog'ozda esa ko'chirish uchun 10 daqiqa bor.

q: Which is the best thesis statement for an 'agree or disagree' essay?
o: I completely agree that public transport should be free, for two main reasons.
There are many opinions about this topic.
This essay will talk about transport.
Some people think yes and some think no.
e: Yaxshi tezis fikringizni aniq aytadi va insho rejasini ko'rsatadi.

q: How many body paragraphs are usually enough in Task 2?
e: Odatda 2–3 ta asosiy abzas yetarli. Har birida bitta asosiy fikr, tushuntirish va misol bo'ladi.

q: Which phrase is too informal for Task 2?
o: kids these days are crazy about phones
young people spend considerable time on phones
many teenagers rely heavily on smartphones
smartphone use among adolescents is rising
e: «kids», «crazy about» so'zlashuv uslubiga xos. Task 2 rasmiy uslubda yoziladi.

q: Which is a good way to give an example in Task 2?
o: For instance, in many Japanese cities, children walk to school on their own.
e: Misol to'liq gap bilan, «For instance» yoki «For example» orqali beriladi.

q: Which conclusion opening is the most appropriate?
o: To sum up all of the above things I said,
At the end of the day, guys,
e: «In conclusion» yoki «To conclude» qisqa va rasmiy. Xulosada yangi fikr kiritilmaydi.

q: Which Task 2 essay type asks you to write about causes and solutions?
e: Causes/problems and solutions savolida ikkala qismga ham teng javob berish kerak.
